{{Quote|One tribe of these Duloks are called the Korga, and they've been become quite adept in killing their cousins, the Ewoks. We figure that if their numbers were whittled down a little, the Ewoks would have a better chance. Here's where the Korga can be found. Travel there and wipe out those little buggers.|A [[Rescue Our Lesser Brothers]] representative, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Endor}}</ref>}}
The '''Korga Cave''' was a cave on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of Endor]]. [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] of the [[Korga]] tribe at one point built a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] outpost within the cavern.<ref name="SWG:KC" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the organization called [[Rescue Our Lesser Brothers]] decided to help the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] species from the violent Duloks. The organization determined that reducing the number of the Korga population could be beneficial for the Ewoks. A representative was then sent to Endor in order to recruit people willing to attack the Korga Cave.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Korga were rumored to have contacts with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:Y">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Yondalla"}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] lieutenant [[Yondalla]] dispatched a spacer to the Korga Cave in order to recover a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] prisoner transfer document stolen by the Rebels.<ref name="SWG:Y" /> Later, a spacer visited the cave and collected an [[Ewok crossbow]].<ref name="SWG:RRWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Rifle Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Korga Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
